fit_rule: RBF and Fourier ridge width and penalty selected by leave-one-out error on public training responses only; privileged Lotka-Volterra four rates fitted by bounded least squares from three fixed starts, with the upstream equation and initial state supplied as an explicit ceiling
score: Mean absolute error and root mean squared error across 16 held-out times and both responses, with nonnegative predictions
interpretation: Three development worlds only. Privileged equation is not inferred by an LM and cannot count as an ACE or foundation-model result. No model selection uses holdout outcomes.
forbidden: No Azure or other closed-source API calls. Fitter reads only public observations; scorer separately reads private holdout.
